Chapter 196 - 196 Milk Tea; I Was Just Saying!

Chapter 196 - 196 Milk Tea; I Was Just Saying!

196 Milk Tea; I Was Just Saying!

Everyone chatted for a while. Lin Fan saw that it was getting late, so he brought Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao out of Feiyang Building under the watchful eyes of Chu Yunyue and the staff of Flower Stem.

Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao were sitting in the Mercedes-Benz G-Class, looking at their big bags of Flower Stem’s essence products in their hands. Their faces were still full of smiles.

Flower Stem’s essence products were something they had always wanted but could not get. Now that they had gotten so many bottles of it, their wish could be considered to have been fulfilled.

If other people knew that they had so many bottles of Flower Stem Essence, they would definitely be so envious that they would drool!

The more they thought about it, the happier the three of them were.

“By the way, Brother, how do you know Sister Chu?” Lin Xiaoyao asked. “Moreover, she actually gave us so many bottles of Flower Stem Essence!”

Lin Fan said, “Oh, I met her at a perfume exhibition… As for why she gave you so many bottles of Flower Stem Essence… Because I’m the biggest shareholder of Flower Stem.”

Silence!

In the Mercedes-Benz, even the air suddenly became quiet.

Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao were all stunned.

After a long time, Lin Xiaoyao finally cleared her throat and said, “Brother… You just said… What?”

“We met at a perfume exhibition,” Lin Fan said.

“The next sentence,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“As for why she gave you so many bottles of Flower Stem Essence?” Lin Fan said.

“The next sentence,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“Probably… because I’m the biggest shareholder of Flower Stem,” Lin Fan said.

“Ah! Heavens! My brother is the biggest shareholder of Flower Stem! Flower Stem belongs to our family! I’ll have an endless supply of Flower Stem Essence in the future!”

Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly.

Then, she hugged Lin Fan’s neck and shouted, “Brother, I love you so much!”

Lin Fan coughed and reminded, “We’re siblings.”

Du Yujia and Tang Jiao looked at Lin Fan with bright eyes.

At Lin Xiaoyao’s request, everyone ate seafood together.

When they walked out of the restaurant, everyone looked satisfied.

“This place is still the best!”

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao saw the long line for the Cha Yue shop across the road. She sighed and said, “Cha Yue finally opened a shop in Jiangbei this year. Why are there so many people?

“From my visit to Jiangbei this time, I got a Gucci bag and Flower Stem Essence. If I can have a cup of milk tea, it would be perfect!”

“Then let’s drink it,” Lin Fan said.

“There are too many people. It’ll take at least one to two hours to get the milk tea. Our train leaves in an hour,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

Lin Fan said, “It’s okay. I’ll make an order on my phone. It’ll be delivered very soon.”

“Order it on your phone?” Lin Xiaoyao asked. “Isn’t Cha Yue against delivery?”

Lin Fan acted as if he did not hear her. He took out his phone and dialed the number of the chairman of Cha Yue, Fang Liang.

Yesterday, after Lin Fan obtained 51% of Cha Yue’s shares, Fang Liang took the initiative to call him.

It was convenient to contact him now.

…

Sha City, Cha Yue’s headquarters.

Fang Liang was holding a high-level meeting with many general managers and directors.

The atmosphere was very serious and intense.

At this moment, Fang Liang’s phone rang.

He frowned and raised his hand to reject the call.

However, when he saw the caller ID, his expression turned solemn. He quickly stood up straight and said in an extremely respectful tone, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

The meeting room suddenly fell silent.

All the executives stopped their discussion and looked at Chairman Fang Liang in surprise.

Many of them had worked under Fang Liang for more than ten years…

However, when had they ever seen Fang Liang so serious when answering a phone call? Why was his tone so respectful?

Mr. Lin?

A man surnamed Lin?

Could it be… Was he the most mysterious major shareholder in Cha Yue?

At the thought of this, all the executives held their breaths.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s voice came from the phone.

“I’m at Cha Yue Milk Tea in Jiangbei City, but there are a lot of people here. Can you get someone to send me a few cups of milk tea?”

“Alright, Mr. Lin. I’ll get someone to send them to you now,” Fang Liang said.

“Mhm, that’s all for now,” Lin Fan said.

“Goodbye, Mr. Lin,” Fang Liang said.

He wanted to drink a few cups of milk tea and called me for it?

Such a small matter?

However, Fang Liang was not angry at all.

On the contrary… his face was full of smiles.

…

Lin Xiaoyao saw that Lin Fan had hung up the call and could not help but ask, “Brother, who did you call?”

“Oh, it’s the chairman of Cha Yue.” Lin Fan shook his head.

“Huh?”

Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao were all stunned.

At this moment, three Cha Yue shop assistants walked over with more than ten different kinds of Cha Yue tea.

“Are you Mr. Lin?” The shop assistant standing at the front asked softly.

“It’s me,” Lin Fan said.

“Hello, these are the cups of milk tea that our chairman asked us to send over,” the shop assistant said.

“Alright, thank you,” Lin Fan replied. “Lil Yao, Yu Jia, Tang Jiao, you guys help carry them. I can’t carry them all.”

“Ah… Ah… Alright,” the three of them responded.

Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao slowly came back to their senses after the shop assistants left.

“Brother, how did you meet the chairman of Cha Yue?” Lin Xiaoyao stammered.

“I haven’t seen him,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Xiaoyao heaved a sigh of relief.

“But I’m the biggest shareholder of Cha Yue,” Lin Fan said.

Silence!

The entire scene fell silent again!

The mouths of Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao were agape again.

He was a shareholder of Gucci, a shareholder of Flower Stem, and now, a shareholder of Cha Yue!

In addition, he also owned more than ten large villas!

Everything that they had experienced today kept rippling in their little minds. It was really… It was too shocking!

Lin Fan did not care much. He looked at his watch and said, “It’s about time. Let’s go. I’ll send you to East Station.”

After the three of them got into the Mercedes-Benz G-Class, he stepped on the accelerator and sped forward.

Not long after, the crowded Jiangbei East Station appeared in their sights.

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao and the other two finally recovered from their shock.

Lin Fan pinched Lin Xiaoyao’s cheeks and said, “Be careful on the way back.”

“Alright,” Lin Xiaoyao replied.

“Eat more. You can’t be too skinny or you might die from complications,” Lin Fan said.

“Brother!” Lin Xiaoyao protested.

Lin Fan watched Lin Xiaoyao and the other two enter the station before turning around to leave.

In the waiting room.

“Xiaoyao, did you say your brother’s single?” Du Yujia asked.

Tang Jiao’s ears perked up.

A handsome rich man who was full of charm!

How could Lin Xiaoyao not understand what they were thinking?

At this moment, she laughed and said, “Did I? I was just saying it casually, haha! Did you really believe it?”

‘Want to f*ck my brother?

‘You guys are still lacking!’
